# Hash-pinned maturin for the CI dependency-submission job (CICD-02, CWE-1104).
#
# That job runs on push to main with contents:write, so its only PyPI-installed
# build tool is pinned to an exact version AND verified by hash rather than
# resolved freely at install time.
#
# Renovate manages this file via its pip_requirements manager (the requirements
# manager updates both the version and the hashes).
#
# On the ubuntu-latest x86_64 runner (Python 3.14) pip selects the manylinux
# x86_64 wheel below; the sdist hash is a defensive fallback (the job carries a
# Rust toolchain able to build it). maturin has no runtime dependencies on
# Python >= 3.11, so --require-hashes needs only these two file hashes.
maturin==1.15.0 \
    --hash=sha256:653020a63525bb224e5ab0adf02e17a2e08bc86dbea7fc1399c9a56d7529b99e \
    --hash=sha256:94b26cc8e8aba61a5f2099715fe640e18c5f678e9a500408b38761263954228a
